flags.item: Wynn dailies during the WPT World Championship
flags.detail: The Wynn daily poster says dailies are suspended during some tournament series. The WPT World Championship (Nov 27 to Dec 21) is a series. Whether dailies run during it is not confirmed. Call (702) 770-7654 (from the Wynn poster).
Each Venetian single-entry row is classed as single-entry because its structure sheet states no re-entry, rebuy or add-on. No official text says 'single-entry'. Treat as inferred until confirmed.

flags.item: Venetian Event 7 may allow multiple flights
flags.detail: The Event 7 structure sheet says a player who bags Day 2 chips may not play a later flight, which implies more than one flight can be entered. Placed in the separate section.
